class CoralLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.linear = nn.Linear(input_dim, 1, bias=False)
        self.register_buffer("cumprobs", torch.arange(num_classes - 1, 0, -1).float())

    def forward(self, x):
        logits = self.linear(x)
        logits = logits - self.cumprobs
        return logits.squeeze()

    def __init__(self, num_classes=6):

    loss = 0.0

class EssayDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, scores, tokenizer, max_len):
        self.texts = texts
        self.scores = scores
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_len = max_len
        self.features = np.array(
            [[len(str(text)), str(text).count("\n") + 1] for text in texts],
            dtype=np.float32,
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encoding = self.tokenizer.encode_plus(
            text,
            add_special_tokens=True,
            max_length=self.max_len,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_attention_mask=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        score = self.scores[idx] if self.scores is not None else 0
        return {
            "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"].flatten(),
            "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"].flatten(),
            "features": torch.tensor(self.features[idx], dtype=torch.float),
            "score": torch.tensor(score, dtype=torch.long),
        }


class CoralLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.linear = nn.Linear(input_dim, 1, bias=False)
        self.register_buffer("cumprobs", torch.arange(num_classes - 1, 0, -1).float())

    def forward(self, x):
        logits = self.linear(x)
        logits = logits - self.cumprobs
        return logits.squeeze()


class EssayScorer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=6):
        super(EssayScorer, self).__init__()
        self.longformer = LongformerModel.from_pretrained(
            "allenai/longformer-base-4096"
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        self.feature_layer = nn.Linear(2, 128)
        self.classifier = CoralLayer(
            self.longformer.config.hidden_size + 128, num_classes
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, features):
        outputs = self.longformer(input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        features_embed = torch.relu(self.feature_layer(features))
        combined = torch.cat([pooled_output, features_embed], dim=1)
        output = self.dropout(combined)
        return self.classifier(output)


def coral_loss(logits, labels, num_classes):
    loss = 0.0
    levels = torch.arange(1, num_classes).to(labels.device)
    for i in range(num_classes - 1):
        mask = labels > levels[i]
        logits_i = logits[:, i]
        labels_i = mask.float()
        loss += nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()(logits_i, labels_i)
    return loss / (num_classes - 1)


def quadratic_weighted_kappa(y_true, y_pred):
    return cohen_kappa_score(y_true, y_pred, weights="quadratic")


def validate(model, dataloader, device, num_classes):
    model.eval()
    predictions = []
    true_scores = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in dataloader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            features = batch["features"].to(device)
            scores = batch["score"].cpu().numpy()

            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, features)
            preds = (
                (logits.sigmoid().sum(dim=1) + 1)
                .round()
                .clamp(1, 6)
                .cpu()
                .numpy()
                .astype(int)
            )
            predictions.extend(preds)
            true_scores.extend(scores.astype(int))
    return quadratic_weighted_kappa(true_scores, predictions)
